summary: Regression smoke test of imported Keuangan-V1 app. Backend: 11/11 pytest passed - health, root, auth login (success + wrong password 401), /auth/me, /meta (channels include Shopee/TikTok Shop/Tokopedia/Website, storage_enabled=false), full flow: create material, product, cash account exists (Kas Utama auto-seeded), inventory adjust (+10 product stock), create sale (net_total/total_hpp/profit populated correctly, stock decreased from 10 to 7), cleanup deletes. Frontend: /login renders, admin login redirects to Dashboard which shows all KPI cards (OMZET, LABA KOTOR/BERSIH, SALDO KAS, NILAI STOK, plus extras). Sidebar navigation to /bahan, /produk, /resep, /penjualan, /pengaturan, /laporan/laba-rugi all render without blank page or page errors. Only console noise is initial 401 on /api/auth/me before login (expected).
critical_code_review_comments: pytest.ini forces '-n 2 --dist loadscope' via addopts which breaks tests that don't have pytest-xdist compatible fixtures (module-scoped state passed between tests). Consider making iteration tests self-contained or run with -o addopts=''.
operations.py apply_sale computes net = gross - discount - fees; if net<0 no explicit check (only total<0). Minor edge case.
master.py simple_crud uses name-or-code truthy check that allows creating category/unit with only code (no name). Low priority.
seed_data_creation: Test flow creates TEST_Material_it5 + TEST_Product_it5 + 1 sale then cleans up (all deleted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with '-o addopts=""' to bypass forced xdist in pytest.ini. Old test files (backend_test.py, test_iteration2.py, test_iteration4.py) reference old admin credentials and should be ignored. Cash account 'Kas Utama' is auto-seeded on first login. Backend URL from frontend/.env.
